title: organism
description: The living agent (apex): one or more cells integrated into a discrete, self-maintaining individual. Homeostasis is its self-maintaining settling (a fixed point of feedback); response-to-stimulus is its perceive→act loop (cognition, even without neurons). Its boundary is genuinely fuzzy (clonal, colonial, lichen, holobiont) — individuality is an open problem. Physiology, development, heredity, behaviour, evolution, and ecology are all structure read off the organism.

self-maintaining.description: homeostasis — stable internal conditions held by feedback (a settling fixed point)

responsive.description: responds to stimuli — the perceive→act loop that makes it an agent

reproduces.description: reproduces and passes on heritable variation (the seed of evolution)
